moments.author: Tom Welling
moments.quote: Posted a hotel window view captioned “Hello NYCC,” but the reflection showed him unclothed; Story stayed up ~10 h before deletion.
moments.why: A classic social media slip‑up—accidental nude reflection during NYCC went viral among pop‑culture and nostalgia‑driven audiences.

moments.author: Tom Welling
moments.why: That simple caption on an Instagram Story became a viral meme when paired with the accidental reflection.

moments.author: Sports
moments.why: A jaw‑dropping serve speed post that spread widely before being corrected—became a lightning rod in sports circles.

moments.author: Sports
moments.quote: Shelton in US Open final — U.S. guaranteed a finalist
moments.why: Ben Shelton’s deep US Open run energized sports fans, especially young men tracking rising American tennis.

moments.author: Sports
moments.quote: Alexander Zverev beats Ben Shelton to win the US Open title
moments.why: Shelton’s final loss in the US Open finale capped a major storyline—his breakthrough and end‑of‑drought narrative trended hard.
